question: Should ClawHub continue handling support for the externally owned OpenClaw bootstrap installer, or redirect this report to that installer's owning repository?
rationale: The reported implementation is absent from ClawHub and the live legacy URL now serves a different external installer, so repository ownership intent is needed before assigning work or closing the support report.

options.title: Redirect to installer owner
options.body: Send current bootstrap-installer failures to the repository owning `openclaw.ai/install.sh` and keep ClawHub support limited to its package and skill-install commands.

options.title: Retain cross-project support
options.body: Keep this issue open and request a fresh macOS transcript if ClawHub maintainers intentionally support the external bootstrap flow here.

recommendation.title: Redirect to installer owner
recommendation.body: Send current bootstrap-installer failures to the repository owning `openclaw.ai/install.sh` and keep ClawHub support limited to its package and skill-install commands.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the strongest current-history candidate for deciding how the ClawHub CLI/install surface should route this external installer report.
